name: Enhance the River (River Health and Community Fund)
summary: Thames Water grants of up to £150,000 for catchment-scale river habitat restoration, fish passage, floodplain reconnection and invasive species work, part of a fund running to 2030. The second application window is open until 11 January 2027.

eligibility.rule: Project is in the Thames Water region
Partnership project is completed by December 2029

status.quote: The second application window is now open and will close on 11 January 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Charities, trusts, and charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs) Community and voluntary groups Community Interest Companies (CICs) Faith based organisations as long as the project is inclusive Other public sector organisations, such as councils and local authorities, can apply for our Enhance the River grant.

window.quote: The second application window is now open and will close on 11 January 2027.

amount.quote: Enhance the River offers grants up to £150,000 for a range of catchment-focused projects.

access.quote: This grant is managed internally. We will handle applications and reporting with the recipient organisation.
